notes: IT'IS eye rows: 'Eye (Cornea)', 'Eye (Aqueous Humor)', 'Eye (Lens)', 'Eye (Vitreous Humor)', 'Eye (Sclera)', 'Eye (Choroid)', 'Eye (Retina)' all exist in the 2026 database; several are mapped by IT'IS from surrogate tissues (retina<-grey matter for k,c,sigma; choroid<-blood).
Gabriel 1996 has no retina, choroid or aqueous humour entry; surrogates are stated per tissue.

Dielectric per_frequency 'sigma' is the IT'IS literature value (frequency-independent below 1 MHz); 'sigma_gabriel_cole_cole' and 'eps_r' are evaluated from the 4-Cole-Cole model in this work (script colecole.py).
Hammer 1995 (fundus tissues) and Bashkatov 2010 (sclera) NIR spectra could not be accessed; retina/choroid/sclera optics are estimates and should be the first targets of a sensitivity study.
